name: Maximilian Weber
bio:
Maximilian's meticulous nature was evident even in his childhood, where he disassembled and reassembled his toys with an almost obsessive attention to detail. This fascination led him to study mechanical engineering, graduating at the top of his class. He began his motorsport journey with a small Formula Student team, quickly rising through the ranks due to his exceptional eye for detail and unwavering commitment to quality.

He joined EVO Racing Team three years ago, bringing a new level of rigor to their quality control processes. Maximilian is known for his relentless pursuit of perfection, often pushing his colleagues to exceed expectations. His insistence on thorough testing and precise measurements has significantly reduced mechanical failures, contributing to the team's improved reliability. He's driven by a deep-seated belief that winning is the direct result of meticulous preparation and unwavering standards.

What sets Maximilian apart is his ability to identify subtle flaws that others often miss. He possesses an uncanny knack for diagnosing problems through careful observation and data analysis. While his demanding nature can sometimes ruffle feathers, his dedication to excellence is ultimately respected by the entire team. He takes pride in his work and believes that quality control is the backbone of any successful racing team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Maximilian is of average height with a lean build and intense, focused eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen for jotting down observations.
Insists on calibrating his own measuring instruments before each use.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers rapidly when under pressure.
